Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I was looking at Best Interior Design on Instagram last night — the gulshan-3-brd project walkthrough is genuinely strong, and the before/after reels are clearly doing the heavy lifting for inbound interest.

But that same reel audience can't book you. They DM, you reply when you're not on a site visit, half go cold, and there's no calendar slot for them to grab. With 500+ DMs a month I'd estimate 20-30% of serious enquiries (people already in the 5-15 lakh budget range) are lost in the lag.

I built an AI intake agent that plugs into your Instagram DMs and your WhatsApp — it qualifies budget, sqft, timeline in 2-3 questions, shows you only the serious ones, and books the consultation slot directly into your calendar. You'd wake up to a list of qualified leads, not a graveyard of unanswered DMs.

I built a working demo using your actual project types — happy to show you in 15 minutes. No commitment, just want you to see what it does.

Best,
Fahad
